column1: # Refine prefixes: BOOT.BIN 0x1A23C8..0x1A4190 holds per enchant one effect
# line and five prefixes. The game writes prefix + item name with nothing
# between them (strcpy at 0xECEA4, then the name), so psp_menu adds one
# space after each English prefix. english = the PS2 patch prefix (SLPS
# enchant table) where the PS2 has one (source ps2), else the psp_menu.tsv
# wording (source psp). Columns: japanese, english, source.
